name: Og
overview: Og was a male figure known as the King of Bashan during the time of the Exodus. His role as a ruler is specifically noted in the context of Israel's journey from Egypt. No tribal affiliation is recorded for Og in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Og appears as a proper name without a given meaning, simply identifying this individual. His title, King of Bashan, indicates his rulership over the region of Bashan, highlighting his political authority during the Exodus period.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Og beyond his identification as King of Bashan. There are no additional relationships mentioned in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Og's significance lies in his position as a king opposing Israel during their wilderness journey. As King of Bashan, he represents one of the regional powers confronted by God’s people under divine guidance. His mention underscores the challenges faced by Israel as they moved toward the Promised Land.
